title: Maqsade Ahle aza sirf Azadari hai
body:
Maqsade Ahle aza sirf Azadari hai
Azadari hai Azadari hai
Nasl dar nasl ye matam ka safar jaari hai
Sahilou'n ki ye sada rakhte hain ghairat ka bharam
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkilei'n talti hai kardete hain lamho me karam
dare moula se talab karna hai khuddari hai
sar kabhi peshe sitamgaar jhukaya na gaya
dushmane sheh se kabhi hath milaaya na gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
kal bhi bezaar the hum aaj bhi bezaari hai
hum ho kal ya ke na ho mahe moharram hoga
har nafs syede mazloom ka matam hoga
nasl dar nasl ghame sheh ka safar jaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chouda(14) sau saal hue moujiza dekhe duniya
ab bhi kehta hai ye lehraake alam ghazi ka
sheh ke ghazi ki juloose me alamdaari hai
silsila ashou'n ka hai karb se hai ghamkhaari
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame shabbir me karte hain ye shabbe daari
is aza se hi to is khoum e bedaari hai
behre touqeer ye soughaat khuda ne dedi
do kate hatou'n se khairaat khuda ne dedi
<<DIVIDER>>
baaqi is khoum me ab tak jo wafaadaari hai
ghame shabbir me ye majliso matam nouha
Afsar o meer hilaal aaqri dam tak hoga
laakh dushman ko ghame shaah se bezaari hai
